title: A month-boundary bug whose cause is shared by the report and invoice numbering
prompt: Bug: the monthly sales report puts some late-evening orders in the wrong month. An order placed at 2026-12-31T23:30:00-05:00 is counted in 2026-12, but that moment is 2027-01-01 in UTC, and all our periods are UTC (see the README). Find the cause and fix it. Tests run with: pytest -q
